description: Scenarios every CatMQ HTTP client must pass against a running service. Each client's conformance runner implements every scenario under the same id, and prints one JSON line per scenario: {"scenario": "<id>", "passed": true|false, "error": "..."}.

environment.CATMQ_URL: The service's base URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:45783. The API is under /api/v1.
environment.CATMQ_API_KEY: An API key the service accepts.
environment.CATMQ_WEBHOOK_HOST: A host name the service can reach the runner's own HTTP listener at, for webhook deliveries. The service must allow http webhooks.

scenarios.description: health() needs no API key and returns status ok and a version.
A wrong API key raises an error with status 401 and code unauthorized.
Create a queue (created), create it again (not created), read it, update one setting, find it while paging through queues, delete it, and get queue_not_found (404) reading it.
Invalid settings raise an error with status 400 and code invalid_request, with a title.
Publish a JSON object, a text body and a binary body, receive them as an object, a string and bytes with their message type and headers, and acknowledge each so the queue is empty.
A batch publish returns a result per message in order; an invalid message is rejected without failing the others.
Publishing twice with the same idempotency key returns duplicate and the same message ID, and stores one message.
Publishing to a queue at its maxDepth raises an error with status 429 and code queue_full.

Extending a lease returns its new expiry; notConsumed redelivers with the next delivery attempt; defer hides the message until the delay passes; acknowledging an unknown lease raises lease_not_found (404).
Acknowledging several leases at once returns a status per lease, notFound for an unknown one.
The consume helper acknowledges messages the handler accepts, redelivers a message whose handler raised, honors a disposition the handler returns, and stops when the queue is idle.
A deadLetter acknowledgment moves the message to the queue's .dlq, and redrive moves it back.
List messages in pages with a cursor, read one by serial number with its body, delete one, and purge the rest.
A named consumer that has received is listed with kind lease, and deleting it removes it.

Register a webhook (a secret is returned once), receive a signed delivery on a local listener, verify it with the client's helper, reject it with a wrong secret or an old timestamp, rotate the secret, and delete the webhook.
